Hermes general memory and Rowan's HMM regime memory are kept separate by table family and namespace ACLs even though they share one SQLite file. These changes allowed Riley/Qwen runs to complete locally with zero model cost.

Paperclip codex_local agents can fail instantly after a desktop Codex update if adapterConfig.command is pinned to an old hash directory under C:\Users\wayne\AppData\Local\OpenAI\Codex\bin. summary: Paperclip's embedded PostgreSQL on Windows can come back as a false database error when loopback traffic to 127.0.0.1:54329 fails but localhost reaches the database. Normalize embedded postgres URLs to localhost in shared DB helpers, and if startup reports pre-existing shared memory blocks, clear the stale postgres process before retrying the server so health checks and the page recover cleanly.

summary: Ocean Quant Lab must not start Replay or write replay command files while Live Sierra is running. Process-path isolation alone is insufficient because an ACSIL study loaded in Live can read a hardcoded D:\Trading\SierraChart-Replay command file. v0.4.51 adds a Replay instance-root guard before opening command files, and OQL launcher/runner now block Replay automation when Live is open.

Ocean Quant Lab runs on one PC where Live Sierra may remain open by design. Do not block Replay work merely because Live is running. The real boundary is that Replay automation must never write legacy shared command files or target Sierra by window/process ambiguity. Use exact Replay executable paths plus the isolated D:\Trading\SierraChart-Replay\connector-control\oql-vwap-replay-isolated namespace; never recreate D:\Trading\SierraChart-Replay\connector-control\vwap-replay-command.txt because the old Live-loaded VWAP DLL contains that string.

Paperclip/OQL connector code must use the isolated VWAP Replay control namespace and exact Replay PID/main-window recalc targeting. v0.4.53 runner preflights the hook, retries reload/recalculate while waiting for fresh status, and accepts observed running followed by auto-stop endDateTime as successful fast completion. The legacy root vwap-replay-command.txt path remains forbidden because an old Live-loaded DLL can read it.

OQL Sierra Replay runner must not treat repeated data_reload_requested as an active replay, and must treat resume-check/running as start accepted. v0453 runner tag 005 adds bounded reload retries, loaded-boundary reporting, running acknowledgement, and avoids reload/recalculate while running. During long replays, status currentChartDateTime may be stale; use lifecycle/candidate CSV tails for progress.

Do not copy, move, delete, restore, translate, or save Replay chartbooks unless the user explicitly approves the exact path and operation. A manual overwrite of OceanTrading-PaperTrading.cht with an older .old2 file changed Replay chart styling/state; recovery was done through Replay Global Graphics Settings. Runner recalculate targeting now excludes Message Log windows and prefers real chart windows.

summary: Never hand-edit Sierra Chart binary .config files. Directly changing D:\Trading\SierraChart-Replay\Sierra4.config from rithmic_v2.trading to scdataallservices caused Sierra to show a configuration file checksum error. Recover by stopping only the exact Replay process, backing up the invalid config, and restoring a Sierra-written valid backup. Future Replay service changes must be made by Sierra itself or by a checksum-aware supported tool.
